test_unary_ufunc: test applying unary numpy ufuncs like np.positive, np.floor, np.exp to a pandas Series
test_binary_ufunc_with_array: test binary numpy ufuncs applied between a pandas Series and a numpy array
test_binary_ufunc_with_index: test binary numpy ufuncs applied between a pandas Series and a pandas Index
test_binary_ufunc_with_series: test binary numpy ufuncs applied between two pandas Series with aligned or shuffled indices
test_binary_ufunc_scalar: test binary numpy ufuncs applied between a pandas Series and a scalar value
test_multiple_output_binary_ufuncs: test numpy ufuncs returning multiple outputs like np.divmod on two pandas Series
test_multiple_output_ufunc: test unary numpy ufuncs returning multiple outputs like np.modf on a pandas Series
test_binary_ufunc_drops_series_name: test that binary ufuncs drop the series name when operands have different names
test_object_series_ok: test that numpy ufuncs work correctly on object-dtype Series with custom __add__ methods
test_object_dtype_ok: test that numpy ufuncs dispatch to custom __add__ on object-dtype Series elements
test_np_matmul: test numpy matmul applied between a DataFrame and a Series
test_np_matmul_1D: test numpy matmul applied between two 1D Index or Series objects
test_array_ufuncs_for_many_arguments: test custom ufuncs created via np.frompyfunc applied to pandas Series with multiple arguments
test_np_trunc: test numpy trunc ufunc applied to a pandas Series with negative and positive values
test_outer: test that np.subtract.outer raises NotImplementedError when applied to a pandas Series and numpy array
test_binary_ufunc_other_types: test binary numpy ufuncs applied between a pandas Series and list, deque, or tuple
TestNumpyReductions_test_multiply: test np.multiply.reduce on pandas Series, DataFrame, Index, and various dtypes
TestNumpyReductions_test_add: test np.add.reduce on pandas Series, DataFrame, Index, and various dtypes
TestNumpyReductions_test_max: test np.maximum.reduce on pandas Series, DataFrame, Index, and various dtypes
TestNumpyReductions_test_min: test np.minimum.reduce on pandas Series, DataFrame, Index, and various dtypes
